metadata_only_policy: Resolve the frozen DOI and retrieve only DataONE/EML science metadata. Do not retrieve any response data entity bytes or row values.
response_semantic_boundary: Future response is recorded semi-annual canopy reappearance among source-semester recorded non-detections. A recorded zero/non-detection is not automatically latent biological absence.
next_if_schema_resolves: freeze exact response data object identity, field/parser semantics, temporal labels/order and calibration/heldout split before opening row-level response
stop_if_schema_ambiguous: do not open response rows to infer schema; preserve metadata ambiguity
